en: Black‑and‑white image of a cobblestone street in a small European town. On the right side stand one‑ and two‑story brick houses with steep gabled tile roofs and small-paned windows; some have half‑timbered details. Trees line the street, and several people, including children, are visible walking or standing. In the background rises a square church tower with a simple façade and two circular windows near the top. The image is framed by a broad white border with worn and stained corners, suggesting an old printed postcard.
